items.work: Piano Quintet in F♯ minor, Op. 67
items.label: Hyperion
items.note: The Quintet is coupled with Elgar’s on this disc. Nigel Simeone’s notes follow the theme Beach took from the finale of Brahms’s quintet through all three movements, to the two F♯ major chords at the end.

links.title: Hyperion CDA68295: Beach Piano Quintet, with Elgar

items.label: Chandos
items.note: Recorded in Orchestra Hall, Detroit, with Barber’s First Symphony. The four movements run 11:06, 7:45, 12:41 and 9:20.
